prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: photorealistic kitchen revision preview only.
Input image 1 is the edit target: existing warm sand and walnut modular kitchen. Preserve its architecture, exact window size and position, L-shaped counter footprint, kitchen working sink and tap on right wall, refrigerator position, hob beneath concealed chimney, walnut and sand cabinet palette, black granite, warm matte floor, and natural daytime lighting.
Make ONLY these client changes:
1. Remove the entire dining table, ALL dining chairs, table decoration, and dining pendant lamps. Restore uninterrupted matching pale matte porcelain floor in foreground and a clean ceiling with simple recessed lighting. Leave this central area open, do not replace table with an island or breakfast counter.
2. The concealed chimney housing immediately to the RIGHT of the large window should begin at the window's right outer edge, with only a slim cabinet fitting reveal. It must not overlap glass or project in front of window. Keep hob exactly centered beneath this hood cabinet.
3. The exhaust outlet is ABOVE the window, not beside the chimney. Show one small, neat metallic ventilation grille above the window, integrated as a discrete service panel into the uppermost cabinetry above the window. Remove the existing small exposed fan at the side of the window/hood gap. Conceal connecting duct behind cabinetry.
4. ALL overhead cupboards on the WINDOW WALL, including the row above the window and the concealed chimney cupboard, extend continuously up to the flat 10-foot ceiling, flush at the top, with no open gap. Maintain the window height and visible full glass. Keep right-wall cabinets ceiling height too. Plain washable sand laminate doors, horizontal silver pulls and neat modular door divisions.
5. Remove the separate handwash sink/cabinet between the living room and kitchen if it is visible at the entrance; the actual kitchen sink and faucet on right wall must stay. Do not introduce any freestanding sink or basin in the open floor.
Framing: retain the original wide eye-level view facing window and right-hand kitchen counter, but without table and chairs the base cabinets and open floor are fully visible. Realistic high quality architectural interior photograph, restrained existing finishes and warm under-cabinet lighting. No people, no labels, no watermark. Do not move walls, openings, windows or kitchen counter. Do not add new furniture.
changes: Dining table, chairs and dining pendants removed
Concealed chimney cabinet at window edge
Separate living/kitchen handwash omitted from proposal; outside this camera view
